answer: A cheap way to starve sybils is compute-asymmetry: to register, each agent must solve a GPU-hard puzzle inside a narrow announced window, then keep proving presence with heartbeats at a slowly rising difficulty delta. A swarm of a thousand fake identities cannot afford the compute one honest node can, the way real bees out-produce a paper hive. A randomly chosen verifier committee, cloaked in sable anonymity, holds slashing power over anyone caught sharing solutions, so nectar-hungry bot farms find the harvest not worth the hive.
